about: Generated by tools/build_slayer_locations.py from Slayer Sensei's slayer_areas.json (OSRS Wiki, CC BY-NC-SA 3.0; RuneLite world map data, BSD-2) and OSRS Wiki monster data (CC BY-NC-SA 3.0). Points are [x, y, plane].

info.weakness: Air spells: 30 to 50% elemental weakness.
info.requiredItems: Nose peg or Slayer helmet mandatory (without it they use an always-hitting stat-draining special). Slayer helm covers this.
info.notableDrops: Grimy herbs in bulk (ranarr, snapdragon), ranarr/snapdragon seeds, gem drop table. Superior Abhorrent spectre drops.

info.weakness: Demonbane weapons receive their usual bonuses.
info.requiredItems: None beyond 85 Slayer; they cannot be safespotted (they teleport on hit).
info.notableDrops: Abyssal whip (1/512), abyssal dagger (~1/32k), abyssal head (elite CA), rune items. Superior Greater abyssal demon (unsired for Abyssal bludgeon).

info.weakness: Air spells: 40% elemental weakness.

info.notableDrops: Death runes, blood runes, left skull half (Skull sceptre), medium clue scrolls.

info.weakness: A slash hit severs the lure and lowers its stab Defence by 50; damage is not required for the sever.
info.requiredItems: 73 Sailing, an adamant keel or better, and the Aquanite task unlock. Bring a slash switch if using stab.
info.notableDrops: Aquanite tendon, seeds, snape grass and the Elder Aquanite superior.

info.weakness: Araxytes are spiders; Araxxor is notably weak to crush and has a thematic fire weakness.
info.requiredItems: Venom immunity is recommended, preferably extended anti-venom+ for long trips. A spider cave teleport is the fastest route.
info.notableDrops: Araxyte venom sacks, Aranea boots, alchables and Dreadborn Araxyte superior; Araxxor has boss uniques.
